about: Models Lumen converts to ONNX itself (plan 6.0), read by .github/workflows/model-convert.yml, scripts/models/*.mjs and src/ai/convertedModels.ts. `hf` is the source checkpoint, `cardLicense` the licence its model card must declare (the workflow refuses a mismatch), `keep` the quantisations published. `mirrors`: existing third-party ONNX builds that are used instead of converting when they load and pass the smoke test.
